This markdown demonstrates the practical use of our proposed helper functions to estimate incremental costs between an intervention and a control group in a minimal simulated dataset.

- **`glmx_start()`** estimates starting values to overcomes errors (glm, glm2) or suboptimal fits (glmmTMB).
- **`get_best_model()`** returns the model with the lowest AIC from all valid models (non-NULL, converged, and valid AIC).
- **`glmx()`** fits multiple regression models using four different packages (`stats::glm(), glm2::glm2(), mgcv::gam(), glmmTMB::glmmTMB()`) and returns the best fitting model.
- **`glmx_events()`** fits multiple regression models for the first stage of a two stage model (probability of events with non-zero costs) using Gaussian with identity-link and Poisson with both identity & log-link, and returns the best fitting model.
- **`glmx_pcosts()`** fits multiple regression models for the second stage of a two stage model (positive costs) using Gamma with identity and log-link, and returns the best fitting model.
- **`predict_one_stage()`** predicts marginal absolute costs and costs differences between groups for a single stage model based on the initial study sample. 
- **`predict_two_stage()`** predicts marginal absolute costs and costs differences between groups for a two stage model based on the initial study sample.

## Setup and Libraries

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)
library(mgcv)
library(glm2)
library(glmmTMB)

# set chunk defaults
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, fig.width = 6.0, dpi = 600, comment = NA)
```

## Robust Regressions

Infrastructure and utility functions (skip ahead to example usage)

```{r robust_regressions}
# overcomes glm/glm2 (log-link) error "no valid set of coefficients has been found: please supply starting values"
glmx_start <- function(formula, data, family) {
  m <- lm(formula, data)
  c <- coef(m)
  if (family$link == "identity") {
    c[is.na(c)] <- 0.0
  } else if (family$link == "log") {
    c[names(c) == "(Intercept)"] <- log(mean(predict(m)))
    c[names(c) != "(Intercept)"] <- 0.0
  } else {
    c[] <- 1.0
  }
  return(c)
}

# utility function to select best regression fit, instrumented to track performance
get_best_model <- function(m_list) {
  returned  <- map_lgl(m_list, ~       !is.null(.x))
  converged <- map_lgl(m_list, ~ifelse(!is.null(.x), class(.x)[1] == "lm" || (class(.x)[1] %in% c("glm", "gam") && .x$converged[1]) || (class(.x)[1] == "glmmTMB" && .x$fit$convergence == 0), FALSE))
  aics      <- map_dbl(m_list, ~ifelse(!is.null(.x), AIC(.x), NA))
  valid_aic <- !is.na(aics)
  if (sum(valid_aic) == 0) { return(NULL) }
  best_aic <- which.min(aics)
  m_list[[best_aic]]$returned  <- returned
  m_list[[best_aic]]$converged <- converged
  m_list[[best_aic]]$valid_aic <- valid_aic
  m_list[[best_aic]]$best_aic  <- ifelse(!is.na(aics), aics == min(aics, na.rm = TRUE), FALSE)
  return(m_list[[best_aic]])
}

# wrapper function around glm, glm2::glm2, mgcv::gam, and glmmTMB::glmmTMB, selecting the best among multiple fits
glmx <- function(formula, data, family) {
  s <- glmx_start(formula, data, family)
  models <- list(NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
  try (models[[1]] <-     glm(formula, family, data, start = s))
  try (models[[2]] <-    glm2(formula, family, data, start = s))
  try (models[[3]] <-     gam(formula, family, data))
  try (models[[4]] <- glmmTMB(formula, data, family, start = list(beta = s), na.action = na.exclude))
  return(get_best_model(models))
}

# wrapper to select the best fit among gaussian and poisson, the latter with identity link or log-link, for counts
glmx_events <- function(formula, data) {
  models <- list(NULL, NULL, NULL)
  try(models[[1]] <-   lm(formula, data))
  try(models[[2]] <- glmx(formula, data, family = poisson(link = "identity")))
  try(models[[3]] <- glmx(formula, data, family = poisson(link = "log")))
  return(get_best_model(models))
}

# wrapper to select the best fit among gamma regressions with identity link or log-link, for positive costs
glmx_pcosts <- function(formula, data) {
  models <- list(NULL, NULL)
  try(models[[1]] <- glmx(formula, data, family = Gamma(link = "identity")))
  try(models[[2]] <- glmx(formula, data, family = Gamma(link = "log")))
  return(get_best_model(models))
}

# utility function to extract marginal absolute cost for single stage model evaluated on population
predict_one_stage <- function(pop, m1, label, shift) {
  costs <- try(pop %>% mutate(costs = predict(m1, newdata = ., type = "response")))
  if (inherits(costs, "try-error")) { return(NA) }
  return(costs %>% group_by(study_group) %>% reframe(value = mean(costs) - shift) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = study_group) %>% mutate(difference = intervention - control, label))
}

# utility function to extract marginal absolute cost for Gaussian/Poisson-Gamma model evaluated on population
predict_two_stage <- function(pop, m1, m2, label) {
  costs <- try(pop %>% mutate(costs = predict(m1, newdata = ., type = "response") * predict(m2, newdata = ., type = "response")))
  if (inherits(costs, "try-error")) { return(NA) }
  return(costs %>% group_by(study_group) %>% reframe(value = mean(costs))         %>% pivot_wider(names_from = study_group) %>% mutate(difference = intervention - control, label))
}
```

## Dataset

```{r dataset}
# ensure reproducibility
set.seed(3.14159)

# fictitious study population (single observation sample)
study_pop <- expand.grid(study_group = c("control", "intervention"), age = seq(40, 99, 0.01)) %>%
  mutate(events = map_int(study_group, ~ rpois(1, 0.200 + 0.100 * (.x == "intervention")))) %>%
  mutate(ecosts = map_dbl(study_group, ~ rexp (1, 0.005 + 0.002 * (.x == "intervention"))) * exp(0.01 * age)) %>%
  mutate(costs  = events * ecosts)

study_pop %>% group_by(study_group) %>% reframe(across(everything(), ~ mean(.x))) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2))) %>%
  flextable() %>% autofit() %>% set_caption("Mean values")
```

Mean cost difference: `r study_pop %>% group_by(study_group) %>% reframe(mean = mean(costs)) %>% reframe(diff = round(mean[study_group == "intervention"] - mean[study_group == "control"], 2)) %>% pull("diff")`

## Example Usage

**Note:** Warnings are expected as we anticipate some models to fail

```{r example}
# Gaussian identity link
m_Gauss  <- lm(costs ~ study_group + age, data = study_pop)

# Gamma log link after shift by 0.01 EUR
m_Gamma  <- glmx(pcosts ~ study_group + age,
                 family = Gamma(link = "log"),
                 data = study_pop %>% mutate(pcosts = costs + 0.01))

# two-stage model for events and costs per event
m_Events <- glmx_events(events ~ study_group + age, data = study_pop)
m_Ecosts <- glmx_pcosts(ecosts ~ study_group + age, data = study_pop %>% filter(events > 0))

# compute estimated costs and cost difference for all regression models including reversion of the 0.01 EUR shift
Gauss_id  <- predict_one_stage(study_pop, m_Gauss, "Single-stage: Gaussian (identity link)", 0.00)
Gamma_log <- predict_one_stage(study_pop, m_Gamma, "Single-stage: Gamma (log link)", 0.01)
ziGamma   <- predict_two_stage(study_pop, m_Events, m_Ecosts, "Two-stage: Counts * Gamma")
rbind(Gauss_id, Gamma_log, ziGamma) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ sprintf("%.02f", .x))) %>%
  flextable() %>% autofit() %>% set_caption("Costs from regressions")
```
